Log apne nazuk dil ke gird deewar banate hain.
Log un satyo par thokar khate hain jo jhooth hona chahte hain.
Ek chalak yojana sabse shant dimaag me janm leti hai.
Ek chalak aasan hazaron talwaron ke barabar hai.
Mahatwakanksha insaan ko apni barbaadi nahi dikhne deti.
Gyan wo langar hai jo shak me bhi mazboot rehta hai.
Langar sirf gahre paani mein tike.
Haasya ajnabiyon ke beech ki khaayi patata hai.
Chalak dimaag ek poori sena ko maat de deta hai.
Teekhe dimaag ko miyaan ki zarurat nahi.
Aatma ki apni tarkshakti hai.
Buddhi bezubaanon ki dhaal hai.
Shaant aatma ek durg hai.
Shaant man shaant sansaar hai.
Prasann hriday tabahi ke deck par naachta hai.
Teekhi dhaar dushman aur dost dono ko kaat ti hai.
Manushya swarg khojta hai, par jail banata hai.
Ek prasann swabhaav sabse accha samaan hai.
Tark sabhyata ke dimaag ka compass hai.
Daya samaj ki sone ki zanjeer hai.
Buddhi woh aag hai jo vicharak ko garmi deti hai.
Vyang dhokhe ke kohre me roshni hai.
Hum taare napte hain, par andar rasta kho dete hain.
Bina gyan ki chaturai zehrile teer jaisi hai.
Buddhi dar se zang laga hua disha suchak hai.
Bhoolna insaan ka swabhaav hai; bhool mein rehna moorhta hai.
Gahra kuan sabse meetha paani de.
Man hi insaan ka maap hai.
Jis haath se khana khao, use hi mat kaato.
Jahaj jab bandar-gah mein ho tab mat aakho.
Chalak dhokebaaz moorkhon ka mukut pehenta hai.
Dil ek aisa dhokebaaz hai jo dimaag ki nahi sunta.
Satya ek nangi devi hai.
Chalak dhokebaaz har hawa ke sath chalta hai.
Jo khud ko chatur samjhe, wah bandar par doobta hai.
Jeebh wahi bole jisse dil bhara ho.
Dar tark ki aankh ko andha kar deta hai.
Chalak shabd kootneeti ke sikke hain.
Dil sabse thande tark ko thukra deta hai.
Ek chatur chaal smarak se zyada chalti hai.
Ek chatur chaal gardan ko rassi se bachati hai.
Jeb munh mein rakhi tez talwar hai.
Moorhta ek bhari bojh hai.
Dil ek aisa kila hai jise todna mushkil hai.
Ghamand girne se pehle taakatwar ko andha kar deta hai.
Chalak bachaav sabse accha hamla hai.
Buddhi rooh ka khaaiyo par koodna hai.
Ahankaar kohre ka bana darpan hai.
Vyang wo chingari hai jo geeli baati ko jalati hai.
Dimaag patthar mein bhi raaste tarash deta hai.
